items.name: Jessica M.
items.quote: Such a great, relaxing space with an amazing variety of equipment and a functional layout. No better feeling than being able to walk into a gym and not feel overwhelmed or unwelcome. BONUS there’s an amazing mini bar with coffee, Oxyshred cans, and supplements! Tried the HYDR8 after my class and it was incredible!  Can’t wait to be using this space more, highly recommend! 💗

items.name: Alana P.
items.quote: Lauren is so welcoming and friendly, she makes you feel like she is your best friend with the level of care and support she provides. This gym is so cute and fresh, just what Cairns needs ✨💕
items.highlight: the level of care and support she provides

items.name: Natalie R.
items.context: First mat Pilates class · Mindbody review
items.quote: This was my first pilates class at Fit-X and first class with Aly, and I loved it! Aly is great, heaps of fun, great technique and just enough intensity. She took the time to chat to most of us before that were new, and check in after. Can't wait to come back.
items.highlight: She took the time to chat to most of us before that were new, and check in after.
